2607.03703.title: Explainable Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Traffic Signal Control
2607.03703.paper_summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for adaptive traffic signal control. However, in safety-critical infrastructure like traffic control, the opaque, black-box nature of deep RL models poses challenges for transportation agency acceptance, regulatory compliance, operational trust, troubleshooting, and fine-tuning. To bridge this gap between high-performance optimization and human-comprehensible interpretability, this effort introduces a novel, explainable entity centric RL framework for safe and transparent traffic signal control. Rather than processing traffic states through monolithic, flat vectors, the proposed architecture disaggregates real-time intersection observations into distinct, high-dimensional lane entities and phase temporal configurations to inherently preserve the structural topology and geometric configurations of the intersection. Relational dependencies and inter-lane conflicts are dynamically extracted via a dual-stage attention network featuring sequential multi-head cross-attention and self-attention blocks. This design yields a real time affinity matrix that quantifies the direct influence of signal phases on specific approach volumes and queues, providing full visual and analytical interpretability. To ensure strict operational reliability, a deterministic action-masking interface is integrated directly into the Proximal Policy Optimization pipeline, explicitly blocking invalid phase transitions to guarantee absolute compliance with established signal timing and safety constraints. Evaluated in a microscopic simulation environment, outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in delay minimization. More importantly, the emergent attention weights align precisely with established traffic engineering principles, offering an auditable, trust-enabling, and deployable architecture for next-generation adaptive traffic control systems.
2607.03703.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習（RL）已成為自適應交通信號控制的一種強大範式。<lb/>然而，在像交通控制這樣的安全關鍵基礎設施中，深度RL模型的不透明黑箱特性對交通機構的接受度、法規遵循、操作信任、故障排除和微調帶來挑戰。<lb/>為了彌合高性能優化與人類可理解的可解釋性之間的差距，本研究引入了一種新穎的可解釋實體中心RL框架，用於安全和透明的交通信號控制。<lb/>該架構不是通過單一的平面向量處理交通狀態，而是將實時交叉口觀測分解為不同的高維車道實體和階段時間配置，以固有地保留交叉口的結構拓撲和幾何配置。<lb/>關係依賴性和車道間衝突通過一個雙階段注意力網絡動態提取，該網絡具有序列多頭交叉注意力和自注意力模塊。<lb/>這一設計產生了一個實時親和矩陣，量化了信號階段對特定進入流量和排隊的直接影響，提供了完整的視覺和分析可解釋性。<lb/>為了確保嚴格的操作可靠性，確定性動作屏蔽接口直接集成到近端策略優化管道中，明確阻止無效的階段轉換，以保證對既定信號時序和安全約束的絕對遵守。<lb/>在微觀模擬環境中評估，該方法在延遲最小化方面超越了最先進的基準。<lb/>更重要的是，產生的注意力權重與既定的交通工程原則精確對齊，為下一代自適應交通控制系統提供了一個可審計、增強信任和可部署的架構。
